notes:
REF-BM-02: Automatically collects title and description only; favicon and preview image are missing.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable, but bookmark notes are not implemented.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs are rejected and the existing ID is returned, but the UI does not guide the user into editing that bookmark.
REF-BM-07: Cards expose title, description, and tags, but show a generated initial instead of the bookmark favicon.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry is a plain comma-separated input with no autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, URL, and tags, but not notes.
REF-BM-14: No #tag query syntax is parsed.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search groups are not implemented.
REF-BM-16: Quoted exact-phrase search is not implemented.
REF-BM-17: Bookmarks have no unread/read-later state.
REF-BM-18: No unread-only view exists.
REF-BM-19: No mark-as-read action exists.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action interface.
REF-BM-21: There is no action applying to the whole filtered collection.
REF-BM-22: Results use a fixed created-date ordering with no selectable sort key.
REF-BM-23: Bookmark notes and markdown rendering are absent.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are absent.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is absent.
REF-BM-26: Bookmark archiving is absent.
REF-BM-27: Only permanent deletion exists; reversible archive is absent.
REF-BM-28: No archived-bookmarks view exists.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are absent.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is absent.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is absent.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are absent.
